import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = 10;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int[][] p = new int[Maxn][Maxn];
    static int[] id = new int[64];
    static int ki = 0;
    static int[] X = new int[1048576];
    static int[] Y = new int[1048576];

    static long power(long base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = result * base % mod;
            base = base * base % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long modular_inverse(long x) {
        return power(x, (int) (mod - 2));
    }

    static void add_mod(int[] arr, int index, int y) {
        arr[index] += y;
        if (arr[index] >= mod) arr[index] -= mod;
    }

    static void subtract_mod(int[] arr, int index, int y) {
        arr[index] -= y;
        if (arr[index] < 0) arr[index] += mod;
    }

    static void fast_walsh_transform(int[] P, int opt) {
        int N = 1048576;
        for (int length = 2; length <= N; length <<= 1) {
            for (int start = 0; start < N; start += length) {
                for (int k = start; k < start + (length >> 1); ++k) {
                    if (opt == 1) {
                        add_mod(P, k, P[k + (length >> 1)]);
                    } else {
                        subtract_mod(P, k, P[k + (length >> 1)]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int) (val * modular_inverse(100) % mod);
            }
        }

        if (n < 6) {
            for (int i = n; i < 6; i++) {
                p[i][i] = 1;
            }
            n = 6;
        }

        int A = (1 << 6) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == 3) {
                id[i] = ki++;
            }
        }

        // Process for X
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[0][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[0][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[1][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[1][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk3 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[2][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[2][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (pp == 0) continue;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if (((msk1 >> a) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if (((msk2 >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if (((msk3 >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nmsk = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    add_mod(X, nmsk, (int) pp);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Process for Y
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
            int msk1 = i & A;
            int msk2 = (i >> 6) & A;
            int msk3 = (i >> 12) & A;
            int mask = 0;
            long pp = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk1 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[3][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[3][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk2 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[4][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[4][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                if (((msk3 >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    pp = (pp * p[5][j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    pp = (pp * (mod + 1 - p[5][j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            if (pp == 0) continue;
            for (int a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
                if (((msk1 >> a) & 1) == 1) {
                    for (int b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
                        if (a == b) continue;
                        if (((msk2 >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
                                if (a == c || b == c) continue;
                                if (((msk3 >> c) & 1) == 1) {
                                    int nmsk = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c);
                                    nmsk ^= A;
                                    add_mod(Y, nmsk, (int) pp);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Walsh transform for X
        fast_walsh_transform(X, 1);
        // Walsh transform for Y
        fast_walsh_transform(Y, 1);
        // Pointwise multiplication
        for (int i = 0; i < 1048576; i++) {
            X[i] = (int) ((long) X[i] * Y[i] % mod);
        }
        // Inverse Walsh transform
        fast_walsh_transform(X, -1);
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < 1048576; i++) {
            ans += X[i];
        }
        ans %= mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
